description: At its heart, MCC Live Show is a live commentary stream, with pre-event analysis and live play-by-play commentary of an event.

MCC Live Show thrives in giving analysis of an event and insights of the players, teams, and games of the event via the live commentary and content surrounding the event, while focusing on the fun aspects of the event.
Via livestreams and social media elements, such as viewer voting, viewers are able to engage with the Live Show and help influence decisions for the Live Show.
With interviews and special cameos, MCC Live Show is able to give a spotlight to content creators in the same space, via rule video appearances, interviews, etc.
